Choose a new website or an existing one, then describe what you want to create or change. Import an HTML website or a saved Oakline project to continue your work.

Export your finished HTML website and save a project file for future edits. When you’re ready to publish, upload the website to your chosen hosting provider.

BEFORE YOU BEGIN

Good questions.
Simple answers.

A little clarity before your next great idea becomes a website.

Give it a try ↗
Do I have to choose a template?

No. New projects begin with an empty canvas. You choose the elements, structure, content and styling. The creator doesn’t make you pick a preset website layout.

Can I edit an existing website?

Yes. Choose “Edit an existing website” when you start, then upload its HTML file or a saved Oakline project. You can add separate CSS through the code editor and upload your images. Scripts, external embeds, server code and external stylesheets are not imported.

How does the AI assistant help?

When connected, it uses your project brief and a text outline of your page to suggest layout and format ideas. It doesn’t replace your website. You can follow the advice or choose to add a suggested empty structure.

Do I need to know how to code?

No. Use the visual tools to add and arrange content. If you want more control, you can also edit the HTML and CSS directly.

Can I save and download my website?

Yes. Download a complete HTML website with your styles and uploaded images. Save an editable project file to reopen later. Designs are not automatically saved to an online account, so keep your project file before closing.

Does Oakline host the websites I create?

The creator currently lets you design and download your website. Publishing, connecting a domain and adding backend features are separate steps with your chosen providers.
